parole.significato: amplifier (appliance or circuit that increases the strength of a weak electrical signal)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Latin amplificātor. Noun 1 sense 1 is a semantic loan from English amplifier. First attested in 1746.

parole.significato: derivative (word that derives from another one)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Latin dērīvātus. Sense 2 and sense 4 are semantic loans from English derivative.
Learned borrowing from Latin generātīvus. Sense 2 is a semantic loan from English generative (grammar).

parole.significato: redemption (system for exchanging points obtained from various promotional campaigns for real prizes and benefits)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Latin redēmptiō. First attested in 1733. Sense 1 is a semantic loan from English redemption. Compare Silesian redympcyjŏ.

parole.significato: solution (homogeneous mixture, which may be liquid, gas or solid, formed by dissolving one or more substances)
parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Latin solūtiō. Sense 3 is a semantic loan from English solution. First attested in the 16th century.
Learned borrowing from Latin tigris. Sense 2 is a semantic loan from English tiger. Sense 3 is a semantic loan from German Tiger.
